mentions.note: (Norway), in Scrimshaw's heat, A.A.A. Half-mile Championship 1931; beat Scrimshaw by about 2 yards in the heat, 1 min. 56 sec.; finalist, struck the wooden border and "spiked" Peltzer; "Johannesssen" is a printed slip

share.d: Johannessen in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1933: 1 mention in 1 issue.
